tasks.title: Create useIssueTimeline hook with RAF throttling
tasks.description: Create useIssueTimeline.ts hook that aggregates data from useIssue, useCoderSessions, and getWorkflowLogs. Implements RAF-based throttling for SSE events (plan_round_start, plan_round_complete, ralph_task_update, build_started, build_completed) to batch updates per animation frame. Constructs timeline array sorted by timestamp. Includes proper cleanup of SSE subscriptions on unmount. Note: timeline label 'Review' maps to Stage.Check.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook aggregates issue, sessions, and workflow log data
RAF batches SSE events per animation frame
Timeline array sorted by timestamp
SSE subscriptions cleaned up on unmount
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Reuse reconstructRoundsFromLogs from useSessionTimeline.ts for plan round inference

tasks.title: Create IssueTimeline component with three-level collapse
tasks.description: Create IssueTimeline.tsx component replacing the horizontal stage progress bar. Default view shows stage name + status icon + duration for each pipeline stage (Created, Plan, Approved, Build, Review, Done). Clicking a completed stage expands to show: Plan rounds (Proposal, Specs, Design, Tasks, Self-review) with duration and verdict, or Build tasks with status. Each expanded section includes 'View session →' link. Current stage highlighted with pulsing dot, pending stages shown as hollow gray circles.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline replaces horizontal progress bar below issue title
Completed stages show stage name + checkmark + duration
Current stage visually highlighted (pulsing dot)
Pending stages shown as hollow gray circles
Plan stage expands to show 5 rounds with status and duration
Build stage expands to show task list with pass/fail/running status
Failed stages display failure icon (red ✗) and remain expandable
Expanded section includes 'View session →' link to SessionPage
Model name shown at bottom of expanded Plan section
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Reuse getRoundColor and round label logic from SessionTimeline.tsx
